description:
VERDANT-X is an innovative team from Agadir, Morocco, turning NASA Earth observation data into smarter farming solutions. For the Field Shift challenge, we aim to build an AI-powered platform supporting sustainable crop rotation and climate-resilient agriculture.

We're looking for passionate minds in AI, Data Science, Software Development, Earth Science, Agriculture, and UX/UI Design.

🌍From space data to smarter farms. Join VERDANT-X!
